name: Detroit Style
summary: Thick, airy, cheese caramelised against the pan wall.

steps.text: Mix to a slack dough. No kneading needed.
Bulk with two folds, then press into a heavily oiled steel pan.
Rest until it fills the pan and jiggles.
Edge with cheese all the way to the walls before topping.

bake.notes: The pan must be well oiled. That fried base is the entire point.

notes: Blue steel pans beat non-stick by a wide margin.
